tracks.text: Montage from the previous episode
Green, fuzzy parasite eggs resembling viruses float in darkness
Speckles of green light fall from the sky over a vast, urban landscape.
Murano stands between suburban houses, staring left, her back to a camellia bush.
Shinichi stands by powerlines and a crosswalk, staring right, his back to a camellia bush
The two float in a void of shattering glass
A green eye opens.
A web of arteries and neurons pulse red, illuminating text, Parasyte: the maxim
Shinichi's parasited right hand smiles with a toothy mouth in the palm. A green eye stares from the thumb.
Shinichi steps into water, rippling its reflection of a dark city and red sky. He stares up as buildings, street lights, and power lines float at odd angles.
A crowd crosses and freezes. Flesh monsters covered in eyes and blades erupt from random people.
Two women stand back to back. A flock of butterflies briefly passes, and the women's head grow into a mass of eyes and blades.
Shinichi stands under water, his right hand over his heart.
Amongst the universe, Shinichi stares forward. A boy with short, brown hair stares right.
An older man in a suit stares left
Rows of eyes and teeth and flesh flash. A girl with back length brown hair stares away from us, at a massive, full moon in a cloudy sky.
She looks towards us, opening her brown eyes. In her place, Mrs. Izumi stares at us with brown eyes. Lines trace across her face.
In a warm, glowing void, Shinichi embrace Murano, both nude.

Shinichi falls from darkness, passing buildings and lights and metal towers. Faces flash by, depicting a gaunt man, Yuko and a girl, a graying man, blood dripping from teeth, and rows of eyes. Shinichi lands in water under a blue sky. His hair slicked back, he holds out his parasited hand.
3 thugs back a woman against a wall. Text, stage 2, The Devil in the Flesh
A salaryman punches the thugs
The woman follows as the thugs lie on the ground in the alley. They walk in a park next to a lake. She stares up at him in the dim light.
A pipe strikes the salaryman's head.
The man turns, his neck at an odd angle, his now pinpoint eyes askew. The other thugs surround them.
Slices appear across his face and unfurl into a spiral of speared flesh. Strikes cut across the thugs.
Her head drops. His face reassembles.
During the day, Shinichi walks down the sidewalk, wearing a backpack.
Text, Migi is Japanese for right
The high school is a large, 4-floor rectangle, including a baseball field, sports field, and 2 story gymnasium. At the gym, Shinichi plays basketball against other boys while the girls watch.
He shoots
Murano blushes. Shinichi blinks.
A boy steps on Shinichi's foot
The boy, with the nametag Nagai, blocks a shot.
He steps back and roughly tosses the ball from behind the 3 point line
Basket
Shinichi looks down. Migi's eye looks at him, then recedes into his hand.
She blushes. Nagai frowns.
Shinichi puts away balls in the supply room. Yuko and Murano open the door.
She walks off. He smiles. Migi emerges phallically
She turns to see him covering his hands over his crotch.
He looks down as Migi closes its eye
She stares
Around the back of the gym, Shinichi looks at Nagai, who looks away
Nagai punches Shinichi in the face. His glasses fall to the ground.
Punches him in the nose, then sweeps his ankle.
Nagai lifts him by the collar
Knees him in the stomach
Migi expands and slams Nagai, who flies 10 feet back. Migi recoils back to Shinichi
Nagai rolls over, onto his hands and knees. He looks back at Shinichi, scrambles to his feet, and runs away
Shinichi stands at a urinal, 3 down from another student
The neighbor notices as this arm moves rhythmically. He runs to the sink and runs water over his hand
Later, in the classroom
Shinichi looks at this hand
The Izumi house, at sunset
Migi narrows its eye
Migi grows blades
Shinichi lies face down on the bed. Migi's elongated finger eye hovers over his head, watching him
People of all ages walk along a sidewalk.
A man tosses a half eaten burger in a trash can next to Shinichi. The man walks away, hand in hand with a woman. Shinichi watches them go, then looks down at the burger in the trash.
The headline Minced Meat Murders displays on a phone. A blond man scrolls the article.
The blond man looks up at the people on the sidewalk
Shinichi glances left
Shinichi stands and walks right
The setting sun casts shadows across the empty, suburban streets.
He enters the alley where he found the parasited corgi
He turns. The parasited blond man stands in silhouette
The mans face slices like an orange peel and unfurls into a tentacle of flesh, forming a blade at the end. It cuts the mans right hand off.
Shinichi gapes at the stream of blood pouring from the  man's arm.
Migi stares, its finger eyes and blades frozen, its mouth unmoving in its palm.
The man's eye bulges forward
Shinichi sweats, shaking

The blond man's flesh blades whip around and swing towards Shinichi, aiming at his neck. Migi flies forward as 3 bladed tentacles, taking out the assailant's whip, neck, and chest. The head falls to the ground, and Migi digs 3 blades into it, pinning it down.
The head dims and deflates.
Migi recoils its tentacles back, returning to hand shape
Shinichi lies in bed
The next day, at a diner labelled PanCake, Murano eats pancakes with whipped cream, custard, and strawberries.
Shinichi stares off
He shoves a whole pancake in his mouth
Neighboring patrons stare at the giggling pair
Later, on the suburban street
He falls back
He stands
She stands by the entrance to a park, beckoning
A cat is buried in the sandbox up to its neck. Nearby boys throw rocks at it.
Shinichi walks towards the cat
He pulls the kitten from the sand.
It runs off
Glaring, Shinichi stands, right fist clenched. He turns and walks to Murano
The boys throw rocks. He plucks them from the air without looking. The boys gape. He looks at the rocks in his hand.
He turns to the boys
The boys' mouths drop. Shinichi turns and calmly walks past Murano, who stares
The sun sets over the suburban town

The pair walk shoulder the shoulder. Murano glances over at him. Her hand sways towards his. Her finger touches his thumb. He reaches out with an open palm, and their hands settle together. The two glance at each other, blushing. They smile, walking hand in hand.
She stops, and looks down at their hands, her left, his right
She stares quizzically, then crosses to his other side, taking his left hand in her right. He puts his right hand in his pocket. They smile.
She starts to run, pulling him with her

A full moon hangs over a urban landscape. A naked woman with shoulder length hair stares up at it from the window of a high building. A naked, muscular man approaches her. His askew, pinpoint eyes stare blankly.
She turns to him, placing her hands on his hips. He places his hand on her shoulders. They close the distance.
Scattered white clouds float over a pale, blue sky. Various pictures appear in the style of a children's book.
A pink bicycle sits in front of a house.
A bald man walks a golden retriever.
A mom unlocks a door as her children follower her.
Potted plants line an alley in front of a brick house.
A woman waters dozens of potted plants with a hose
A girl stands in front of a gate with a lunch box
A white door with yellow trim
A rose bush grows around a front gate
6 cats sleep in front of a door
A girl with back length hair runs out of a front door, her mother watching
A traditional gate is covered in snow
A woman with shoulder length hair walks into the entryway of a high rise
An elderly couple pray at a small shrine
A bush is neatly trimmed next to sliding doors
A car sits in a car park next to a pair of doors at a duplex
A subway door opens, and a crowd emerges

A single orange flower grows at the base of a tree. Roots stretch out. The trunk of the tree rises higher and higher, eventually branching out as the trunk narrows, hosting enough leaves to block out the sky.
The front gate at the Izumi house lies open. The front door opens, and Shinichi approaches the foyer, wearing glasses, a gray hoodie, and blue sweat pants. He smiles quizzically.
Red text in the window, Parasyte the maxim
Post-episode footnote: Japanese schools play a standard tune at the end of the school day, 4 notes forward then backward. C, E, D, G, then G, D, E, C.
